youtube.title: Alexander the Great named a city after his DOG 🐕 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Alexander the Great conquered half the world… then ran out of city names. 🗺️

After the 15th Alexandria, he used his horse. Then his dog.

Comment what YOU'D name the next city 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Plutarch: Alexander founded many cities called Alexandria, named Bucephala (326 BC, India) after his horse Bucephalus, and is said to have founded a city named after his dog Peritas.
